facts.text: I had an outreach event at a church to help people dealing with grief during the holidays.
I am JR and I am the Senior Pastor at Westshore Christian Church.
I welcomed attendees to an event called "Hope for the Holidays" at Westshore Christian Church.
I said that on August 11, 2020, my mom died suddenly and unexpectedly.
My mom had been diagnosed with cancer before she died.
My mom called me on the phone from Virginia to tell me about the cancer.
I was serving a church in New York at the time my mom called.
After my mom’s cancer diagnosis, the cancer was operable and there would be a little bit of chemo.
A week after my mom was told the cancer was operable, my mom died suddenly of a heart attack.
I am a pastor and people call me when they need counsel, comfort, and prayer.
It has been over 2 years since my mom died.
I said I decided to have a time of support and encouragement that night because I know what people need right now.
I said I have been telling people for years that I was going to write a book on grief and mourning.
I said I will dedicate the book to my mom when I finish it.
I mentioned that my son Zach’s birthday came shortly after my mom died.
I mentioned that Rudolph, Veteran’s Day, and my Christmas tree and her gifts were sudden reminders for me after my mom died.
I mentioned that my birthday is coming up.
